Message.MsgText: The ''parameter name'' parameter must be set to use the SAP IDocs Connector.

Explanation.p: A value is required for this RFC Connection parameter for either the RFC Server or RFC Client connection.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify the required parameter in the Connector.

Message.MsgText: Optional RFC Connection parameter ''parameter name'' set with the value ''parameter value''.
Connector configuration parameter ''parameter name'' set with the value ''parameter value''.
Checking if TID Manager for TID ''TID'' is available for processing.
No TID Manager found for TID ''TID''.

Explanation.p: The Connector IDoc Inbound queue has a key of the given transaction identifier but has not had a TID Manager object created.

OperatorResponse.p: An internal error occurred. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: TID Manager for TID ''TID'' is available for processing.
Provided poll time value is 0 or less. Single request will be processed only.

Explanation.p: The Connector will operate in standard Iterator mode. Only one IDoc request will be processed by the Connector. After all the IDocs have been place in the AssemblyLine as SyncWeave entries, the Connector will return null to exit Iterator mode.

OperatorResponse.p: Check that this was an intentional action. If not the poll time must be greater then zero.

Message.MsgText: Polling for next the IDoc request in getNextEntry method.
Exception generated while polling.

Explanation.p: Unexpected error has occurred in Thread.sleep(pollTime).

OperatorResponse.p: Restart the AssemblyLine of the Connector.

Message.MsgText: Null Entry found in the Entry list of the TID Manager for TID ''TID''.

Explanation.p: Unexpected error has occurred. Null entries should not be possible in a TID Manager.

OperatorResponse.p: An internal error occurred. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: No TID provided with this RFM call. Manually removing the TID Manager to complete the TID Management cycle.

Explanation.p: An RFM request has been processed by the Connector, where no transaction identifier was provided.

OperatorResponse.p: No response required. RFM Entry will be place on AL the same as is done for IDoc entries.

Message.MsgText: No Parser Attached to the Connector.
Finished processing TID Manager for TID ''TID'' . TID ready for confirmation.
The getNextEntry method returned null in Iterator mode with a valid poll time.

Explanation.p: The modified Iterator mode to act as a Server has failed. Exception has been thrown to prevent standard Iterator mode taking place.

OperatorResponse.p: An internal error occurred. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: Entry contains no XML attributes to parse.

Explanation.p: An XML Parser has been attached but there are no XML valued attributes available.

OperatorResponse.p: An internal error occurred. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: Attempting to parse XML content with attached Parser.
The attached Parser returned a null Entry.

Explanation.p: A Parser has been attached but no entry with parsed attributes was produced.

OperatorResponse.p: Check that an XML Parser was used, and that the parser was configured correctly.

Message.MsgText: Unable to start the JCo IDoc Server.

Explanation.p: The Connector was not able to start the internal JCo IDoc Server.

OperatorResponse.p: The problem may be caused by invalid Config parameters. Verify the Config parameters of the Connector are set properly. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

OperatorResponse.p: The problem may be an issue with the JCo middleware. Verify the JCo middleware is installed properly with all dependent libaries. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: No value provided for current transaction identifier. This list of IDocs will not be processed.

Explanation.p: The Connector received a handleRequest method callback without a prior onCheckTID method call.

OperatorResponse.p: The problem may be an issue with the JCo middleware. Verify the JCo middleware is installed properly with all dependent libaries. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: Current TID ''TID'' already has a TID Manager and is being processed. Ignoring this request.

Explanation.p: The Connector received a second handleRequest method callback for a particular transaction identifier.

OperatorResponse.p: The problem may be an issue with the JCo middleware. Verify the JCo middleware is installed properly with all dependent libaries. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: No IDoc Entries available. Ignoring request for TID ''TID''.

Explanation.p: The Connector received a handleRequest method callback for a particular transaction identifier but no IDocs were contained in that request.

OperatorResponse.p: The problem may be an issue with the JCo middleware. Verify the JCo middleware is installed properly with all dependent libaries. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Explanation.p: The Connector encountered a null IDoc object.

OperatorResponse.p: The problem may be an issue with the JCo middleware. Verify the JCo middleware is installed properly with all dependent libaries. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: The handleRequest method was invoked. Current TID value is ''TID value''. Incoming RFM request is ''RFM name''.
No TID received with this RFM request. Defaulting for TID Management processing.

Explanation.p: The Connector has received a request that contains a SAP client Remote Function Call. No transaction identifier has been provided with the request so the Connector will use a dummy value for the purposes of TID Management.

OperatorResponse.p: No response required.

Message.MsgText: RFM as XML: [''TID''].
Unable to convert RFM request into a SyncWeave entry. No RFMs provided in request.

Explanation.p: The Connector has received a request that should contain a SAP client Remote Function Call, but the Connector was not able to produce a SyncWeave Entry for the RFM.

OperatorResponse.p: The problem may be an issue with the JCo middleware. Verify the JCo middleware is installed properly with all dependent libaries. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: Unable to convert RFM request into a SyncWeave entry. The JCO.Function object received was null.

Explanation.p: The Connector has received a request that contained a null JCO.Function object. This should not happen a may indicate a problem in the JCo middleware or the Connector configuration.

OperatorResponse.p: The problem may be an issue with the JCo middleware. Verify the JCo middleware is installed properly with all dependent libaries. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: Storing RFM request as XML file ''file name''.
Failed to read RFM request XML file ''file name'' into SyncWeave Entry. No contents found in file.

Explanation.p: The Connector stores RFM as a file that contains their XML form as part of RFM processing. This message indicates that no XML content was available from the file.

OperatorResponse.p: An internal error occurred. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: Failed to process RFM XML file. Exception occurred: exception

Explanation.p: The Connector stores RFM as a file that contains their XML form as part of RFM processing. This message indicates an exception occurred while handling the file.

OperatorResponse.p: See the exception message for additional information on how to respond. Attempt to restart the AssemblyLine containing this Connector. If the problem persists, contact SyncWeave support.
